fusions.name: Pilfered Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a dart of shadow at the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt. It has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tumble Through
fusions.desc: Tumbles through a crowd, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 2 tiles and turning it against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, with 15% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Sleight of Wing
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
